source_target_applicability.source: materialized actor/place with committed knowledge evidence
source_target_applicability.target: approved neighboring actor/place reachable by an approved communication carrier/path

payload.path_or_neighbor_rule: only a pinned approved graph edge or route whose applicability permits the carrier and rumor process

exact_timing_rule.formula: sum exact RationalMinutes traversal and transfer durations of the bound carrier path

effect_rule_definition.result: candidate knowledge record with rumor status; never verified fact by default

termination_and_replacement_rules: terminate when no unvisited approved neighbor remains
terminate at a pinned maximum lifetime if the process profile supplies one
replace only through an explicit stronger process instance with a distinct idempotency identity
visibility_and_knowledge_rules: knowledge is added only after exact arrival and domain validation
rumor content remains distinct from verified fact status
distortion requires a separate approved rule
